review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Supervisor(a) de Turbinas based in Brazil. This role is responsible for supervising the assembly and installation of hydroelectric turbines across large-scale energy projects. You will oversee field execution for Kaplan and Francis turbines, ensuring that work meets contractual deadlines, technical specifications, and quality standards. The position combines hands-on technical leadership with planning, resource coordination, contractor management, and safety oversight. You will work closely with site and construction management teams to coordinate activities and ensure the right people, tools, and resources are available. The role also involves resolving technical issues, managing documentation, and supporting engineering teams through non-conformity analysis and corrective actions. You will contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement by training customer teams and capturing lessons learned from projects. This is a remote-based position with frequent travel to project sites across Brazil and internationally. Accountabilities Supervise the assembly and installation of Kaplan and Francis turbines at hydroelectric power plants and small hydroelectric plants, ensuring compliance with schedules, contractual requirements, technical specifications, and quality standards. Collaborate with site and construction managers to plan the sequence of activities and ensure the availability of qualified personnel, tools, equipment, and other required resources. Monitor the capabilities and performance of third-party contractors, ensuring that work is executed according to established procedures, technical specifications, and quality requirements. Ensure all field activities comply with applicable safety standards, company procedures, and local regulations, prioritizing the protection of personnel and equipment. Maintain accurate and up-to-date control of technical drawings, documentation, and project records. Identify and document non-conformities through NCRs and coordinate appropriate technical solutions with engineering teams. Provide training to customer teams on system operation and offer ongoing technical support during and after the turbine assembly process. Analyze field processes and share lessons learned with engineering and project teams to improve future project execution. Support effective communication between field teams, engineering, construction management, contractors, and customers throughout project delivery. Requirements Completed technical education in Mechanical Engineering Technology, Electrical, Electrotechnical studies, or a related technical field. Previous professional experience supervising turbine assembly activities in hydroelectric power plants. Strong understanding of turbine assembly, installation procedures, technical documentation, and field execution practices. Experience coordinating third-party teams and monitoring compliance with technical and quality standards. Ability to interpret technical drawings, identify non-conformities, and collaborate with engineering teams to resolve technical issues. Strong safety awareness and commitment to maintaining safe working conditions in project environments. Intermediate Spanish proficiency. Intermediate English proficiency is considered an advantage. Strong communication, coordination, problem-solving, and leadership skills. Ability to work effectively in dynamic, project-based environments and coordinate multiple priorities. Willingness and availability to travel frequently within Brazil and internationally, including extended assignments at project locations. Ability to work remotely when not deployed to project sites. review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 职位描述： 作为一名软件验证工程师，您需要与Autoflight各团队成员一起编写和执行测试用例和过程，以验证在V2000EM飞机上运行的软件完全正确地实现了系统、指定的高层次和低层次需求。您的工作是至关重要的，以确保Autoflight和选定的第三方的开发达到了质量和安全水平，以获得CAAC的认证。 在此范围内，您的职责如下： 根据DO-178C目标，对嵌入式软件系统进行验证和确认，包括低层次、高层次和系统测试。 设计和实施测试计划、程序和脚本，以验证软件的功能、安全性，并符合法规标准。 分析和审查软件需求、设计文档和源代码，以确保完整性和正确性。 执行基于需求的测试，并进行代码覆盖率分析，以确保符合适当的软件级别（可预见的B、C或D）。 根据DO-178C和Autoflight的计划和标准，制作验证报告、测试摘要、可追溯性矩阵和其他必要的文件。 与软件开发团队协作，识别、跟踪和解决在验证过程中发现的缺陷。 使用用于软件开发，验证和自动化的工具，确保在适用的情况下根据DO-330进行适当的鉴定。 支持监管机构（CAAC）的内部和外部审核、评审和认证活动。 参与变更控制委员会的工作。 持续评估和改进验证过程，以确保高质量、高效和合规的软件验证实践。 Autoflight是一家在中国和欧洲（德国）设有办公区的国际公司。虽然该职位位于中国上海，但很大一部分互动将与讲英语的第三方进行。 职位要求： 计算机科学、电子学或系统工程的学位。曾参与过汽车、医疗或（理想情况下）航空领域安全关键设备嵌入式软件的开发或验证。 在软件开发、验证和测试方面有3-5年的经验，最好在航空航天行业有与DO-178C、DO-331和DO-330相关的工作经验。 熟悉各种编程和脚本语言 (C, C++, python, bash…)。 熟悉软件验证中使用的自动化测试工具和环境. 对认证标准和流程有深刻的理解。 能够在高度监管的环境中严格遵守安全和验证流程。 能熟练地进行英语阅读、写作、理解和交流。
